nodes.summary: Run tesseract OCR on an image to extract text. Supply the image with either `url` (downloaded over HTTP) or `path` (a local file under the system temp directory); provide exactly one of them. Requires tesseract installed on the system. Default language: chi_sim+eng.

url.description: Image URL to OCR (provide url or path, not both)

path.description: Absolute path to a local image file. Must be located under the system temp directory. Provide url or path, not both.

side_effects: reads image from url or local temp path

nodes.summary: Send an image to an OpenAI-compatible vision API (default: gpt-4o-mini) for AI-powered description. Supply the image with either `url` (downloaded over HTTP) or `path` (a local file under the system temp directory); provide exactly one of them. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY (or VISION_API_KEY) env var. Supports OPENAI_BASE_URL for custom endpoints.

url.description: Image URL to analyze (provide url or path, not both)

path.description: Absolute path to a local image file. Must be located under the system temp directory. Provide url or path, not both.

prompt.description: Custom prompt for the vision model

side_effects: reads image from url or local temp path
